name: github-actions
// why: The composite actions' JavaScript was invisible to `pnpm lint`. Nx lint targets are per-project and `.github/actions` belonged to no project, so `nx run-many -t lint --all` (what ci.yml gates on) and `nx affected -t lint` (what the pre-push hook runs) both skipped roughly 4,000 lines of dispatch-broker control-plane code. Nothing was ignoring it; nobody was asking for it. This project exists so the @nx/eslint plugin infers a lint target here like anywhere else.

build.// why: Stage 1 of the dispatch-broker TS migration (language change comes in Stage 2). dispatch-broker/action.yml runs from a committed, dependency-free bundle instead of loose source files -- the runners it dispatches on never run `pnpm install` (agent-router.yml goes straight from checkout to this action; claude.yml verifies the broker binding before any Node setup), so a bundle that inlines everything at build time is the only way to run code that imports the workspace-local libs/dispatch-contracts package there. `nx build github-actions` (this target) is how the committed bundle at dispatch-broker/dist/main.mjs gets (re)produced; ci.yml's Verify job reruns it and diffs the result against what is committed to catch drift.
